data.description: RED task. Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_concurrency.py exposing: snapshot_head(repo_root) -> str (returns tickets-branch HEAD SHA via git rev-parse); rebase_retry(repo_root, write_fn, *, max_attempts=3) -> Result (wraps write with rebase-retry loop, git fetch + git rebase on push rejection). Structured events with kind field: abort_due_to_drift, reject_and_reschedule, abort_due_to_error. No persistent state across passes — all retry counters in local frames. Module is inert on its own; callers wired by subsequent tasks.
data.title: Create _concurrency.py with snapshot_head, rebase_retry, and structured event kinds
